title: A revision's owner photos are read from the object store several at a time, in order, each still checked
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Forty photos are read with more than one and at most PICTURE_READS_AT_ONCE reads in flight, and come back in the rows' order.
A photo whose bytes are missing or of another hash is left out, as before.

tests: photos are read several at a time, at most PICTURE_READS_AT_ONCE, and come back in the rows order
a photo whose bytes are missing or of another hash is still left out
